info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Update Servicing Mandate API
info.description: The Update Servicing Mandate API enables financial institutions to modify existing servicing mandates efficiently. This allows users to change parameters related to ongoing banking services, ensuring that mandates remain up-to-date with the customer's needs. Typical consumers of this API include banking apps and internal systems that manage client accounts. By providing a streamlined way to adjust mandates, this API enhances customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.
